# ADR-NNNN: Title

## Status

Proposed | Accepted | Superseded | Amended

## Date

YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What is being decided, why it came up, and which options were considered.

## Decision

Numbered, testable statements. Link the specs this ADR authorizes.

## Cost comparison

Follow the budget-model style in [operations.md](../specs/operations.md):

- Name the region, unit rates, and price-snapshot date
- Compare build vs buy, or the real alternatives under consideration
- Show always-on / asleep monthly cost and at least one play-hour scenario
- State break-even and what the extra money buys
- Estimates are a budget model, not a quote

A one-line "this is cheaper" is not a comparison. Agent-config ADRs may use token/context cost when there is no AWS line.

## Consequences

What becomes true, what is now out of scope, and what later work must not undo.
